text: Do you want to win... or do you want peace?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Picture Leo. He waits for his boss to notice him... and loses the promotion.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli wrote... a wise prince should establish himself on that which is in his own control... and not in that of others.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Now picture Sara. She wins everything... and still feels homesick inside.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Rumi wrote... he who abides far away from his home... is ever longing for the day he shall return.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: They're not enemies. Machiavelli wins the game outside... Rumi guards the home inside.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Your action today: finish one thing in your control... then take five quiet minutes, no phone.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Win or peace... which comes first for you? Comment below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz for your daily mindset.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
